assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq 2000, 100 nt PE), cerebellum and striatum, male Hsd:ICR mice, generation 66 of a selection experiment
primary_estimand: Associational difference in brain gene expression between a line selectively bred for high voluntary wheel running (Hi, line 7) and a non-selected control line (Co, line 1), within cerebellum (CeHi-CeCo) and striatum (StHi-StCo), plus the line-by-region interaction. All mice had 6 days of wheel access before sampling, so the contrast is genetic line (dominated by 66 generations of selection) with the running amount co-varying; it is not a randomized exercise intervention (S2.1.p3, S4.p3).
sample_inclusion: 16 samples (4 per line-region cell); one StHi sample removed as PCA outlier (S2.2.p1) -> 15 analysed; GEO deposits exactly these 15.
planned_contrasts: CeHi vs CeCo within cerebellum (S2.2.p2; Table 1/Table 3; reported as CeCo-CeHi)
StHi vs StCo within striatum (S2.2.p2; Table 1/Table 4; reported as StCo-StHi)
line-by-region interaction (S2.2.p2, S3.2.p1: 86 genes at FDR < 0.05; 334 at raw P < 0.005)
StHi vs CeHi (third orthogonal contrast, S2.2.p2; no count reported)
main effect of line Hi vs Co across regions (S2.2.p2, S3.6.p1; Table 5; 144 genes |log2FC|>1 in Table E, 122 genes after removing interaction genes; p rule not stated)
main effect of region St vs Ce (S2.2.p2, S3.7.p1; 243 genes at FDR < 1e-15 excluding interaction genes)
repeated_measure_unit: not stated by the authors; S2.2.p1 ('16 individual mouse samples'; 'half of the samples ... St and the rest ... Ce' within line) is compatible with 8 mice x 2 regions. Animal ID not deposited; candidate key = title suffix within line. Paper fits no animal term.
normalization: Cuffnorm v2.2.1 library-size normalized gene counts; genes with >= 1 CPM in >= 3 samples kept (15,213 genes); TMM (S2.2.p1)
paper_method: edgeR 3.14.0 GLM ~ line + region + line:region, robust tagwise dispersion, quasi-likelihood F-test, BH FDR (S2.2.p2)
paper_results: Interaction: 86 genes FDR < 0.05 (76 also FDR < 0.05 in a within-region line contrast); Table 1 top interaction genes; Table 5 top line main-effect genes; Tables 3-4 GSEA: oxidative phosphorylation and ribosome enriched among genes higher in Co than Hi in both regions
